[Phoenix Medical Systems](https://www.phoenixmedicalsystems.com/) offers specialized neonatal intensive care, maternal care, and assistive technology products. Their primary equipment lineup features infant warmers, incubators, phototherapy jaundice management units, respiratory and CPAP systems, and obstetrics-gynecology delivery furniture. [](https://www.phoenixmedicalsystems.com/all-products)

- **Warmers:** Comprehensive Intensive Care Centre (CIC 101), Neonatal Resuscitation Care System (NRC 100), and Embrace Portable Infant Warmer

- **Incubators:** Neonatal Intensive Care Incubators (INC 100, INC 200) and Transport Incubator (TINC 101)

- **Jaundice Management:** Brilliance Pro and Nymphaea phototherapy machines

- **Respiratory Care:**

SVAAS smart nCPAP, NeoBreathe foot-operated resuscitator, and Nasal CPAP Unit 300

- **Therapeutic Hypothermia:** Brammi system [](https://www.phoenixmedicalsystems.com/all-products)

### Maternal Care & Hospital Furniture

- **Delivery & Recovery:** Labour/Ob-Gyn Delivery Table (DT 100) and Labour Delivery Recovery Bed (LDR 100)

- **Infant Care Accessories:** Infant Bassinet (BAS 101) and Electronic Baby Weighing Scale (BWS 101) [](https://www.phoenixmedicalsystems.com/all-products)

### Assistive Technology

- **Mobility:** Arise Standing Wheelchair

- **Visually Impaired Aid:** SmartCane electronic travel cane [](https://www.phoenixmedicalsystems.com/all-products)
